reviews.verdict: Reconsider fallback conclusion for disjoint present boxes.
reviews.basis: ADR explicitly considers corner-touching Crop/Media, then treats default as recovery from empty intersection. Table31 and §14.11.2.1 supply absence defaults, while an explicit processor shall requires intersection for supplied boxes. Nothing cited converts an empty result to absence. The new ViewAreaMedia control avoids the separate need for an empty output target. Reference-reader refusal is neither a pixel oracle nor justification for painting excluded content.
